product.description: Trei tineri moștenitori, întemnițați de un unchi fără scrupule, evadează ndash; spre mare, spre străzi, spre bătălii îndepărtate ndash;, așteptând ziua în care se vor întoarce să-și revendice moștenirea.Sebastian Easton a jurat mereu că își va răzbuna tinerețea răpită și titlul furat. Acum, întors în Londra ca adevăratul duce de Keswick ndash; rănit, călit în război și complet schimbat de experiențe tragice ndash;, nu o poate uita pe fata curajoasă care cândva i-a salvat pe el și pe frații săi de la o moarte sigură. Lady Mary Wynne-Jones a plătit scump pentru ajutorul oferit tinerilor lorzi de Pembrook întemnițați. Dar își amintește bine promisiunea pe care i-a făcut-o lui Sebastian cu ani în urmă: să se reîntâlnească la ruinele mănăstirii unde au împărtășit un sărut pasional și interzis. Deși Mary este acum logodită cu un alt bărbat, o prietenie clădită pe taine întunecate nu poate fi ignorată. Curând, sentimentele neașteptate și periculoase care se nasc între ei îl ispitesc pe Sebastian să renunțe la misiunea lui de răzbunare și, în schimb, să lupte pentru o iubire ce l-ar putea elibera pentru a doua oară.

# The Trial of a Lord by Litera

Immerse yourself in a world of high stakes, forbidden passion, and old aristocratic secrets with *The Trial of a Lord*. This captivating historical romance plunges readers into the dramatic life of noble heirs fighting for their rightful place and love.

---

## A Tale of Revenge, Duty, and Destiny

When three young inheritors are betrayed by an unscrupulous uncle and forced into exile, they flee towards distant battles, waiting patiently for the day they can reclaim what was stolenâtheir fortune and title.

Sebastian Easton vowed never to forget the lost years of his youth or the title unjustly stripped from him. Now returned to London as the true Lord of Keswick, he is a man irrevocably changed by war, injury, and tragic experiences. Yet, even amidst his quest for revenge, he cannot forget the courageous lady who once saved both him and his brothers from certain death: Lady Mary Wynne-Jones.

Lady Mary paid a steep price for helping the young lords of Pembrook. But she vividly recalls the promise she made to Sebastian years agoâa meeting at the ruins of a monastery where they shared an illicit, passionate kiss. Although Mary is now betrothed to another man, the friendship built upon dark secrets cannot be ignored.

As unexpected and dangerous feelings bloom between them, the call for revenge forces Sebastian into a difficult confrontation. He must decide whether to continue fighting for his legacy or risk everything for a love that promises to liberate him once more.

## Why Readers Love This Historical Romance Drama

*The Trial of a Lord* combines the sweeping drama of aristocratic life with the intensity of passionate romance. This book is perfect for fans of grand historical fiction, focusing on:
*   **Intrigue and Secrets:** Unraveling family mysteries within prestigious English estates.
*   **High Stakes Conflict:** Balancing personal desires against inherited duty and reputation.
*   **Passionate Chemistry:** A deeply emotional story about the enduring power of forbidden love.

---

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book purely a romance novel?**
While it features intense, passionate romantic elements, *The Trial of a Lord* is rich in historical drama and aristocratic mystery, making it an ideal blend for fans of both genres.

**Who are the main characters?**
The story centers on Sebastian Easton, Lady Mary Wynne-Jones, and the young lords of Pembrook as they navigate betrayal, revenge, and unexpected love.

**Is this part of a series?**
This book launches into a dramatic world of heirs and secrets, drawing readers into an unfolding saga of passion and destiny.
